findings.title: The sudoers rule does not authorize the installer command
findings.description: `MT_INSTALL` is defined on line 9 but omitted from the root command grant on line 13. `cutover_common.install()` invokes the installer with `sudo=True` (lines 132–135), so the cutover cannot install the requested ref under this sudoers configuration. Include the alias in the grant.

findings.title: Sudoers wildcards allow more than the named operations described
findings.description: The comment says access is limited to named units and exact commands, but `mt-*` and `*` are broad argument wildcards. In sudoers, wildcards can match whitespace and additional arguments, so the operator can potentially invoke systemctl with extra options or pass arbitrary arguments to `mt-run`. Restrict arguments to the specific units and wrapper invocations the cutover needs, or use a narrowly validating root-owned wrapper.
